name: Harmony 350, the TV's power on delay at 10 s
description: todo-compile-350 1.8, one write of lab/work/350-delay/before.bin: the bench configuration with the LG TV's power on delay at 100 tenths, the Denon's untouched. Written down before the run: Volume Up pressed straight after the TV's PowerOn is held back until the delay has run, so it arrives about 10 s after PowerOn; the other file, 350-1-8-delay-3s.json, is the same test at the other value. If the gap comes out in another ratio than 10 to 3 between the two runs, the unit is not tenths on this family and the change still worked. The control step: Volume Up pressed long after the delay goes out at once. The 350 has no screen, so the receiver is the only witness.

steps.instruction: Unplug the Harmony 350 from USB and point it at the receiver. Press the TV's device key once so the remote is in the TV's mode
Press Power, once. If the monitor shows PowerOn, the remote thought the TV was off: press Power once more so it shows PowerOff. Stop when the last thing heard is PowerOff
Wait a moment, then press Power and straight after it tap Volume Up once, briefly. Do not press anything else until Volume Up has been heard
Wait fifteen seconds, then tap Volume Up once. This is the control: with the delay long run out it should go at once
Press Power once, to leave the TV off
